ax = axes[1, 0]
for (cc, c) in zip(np.linspace(-24, 24, 5), COL):
    ax.plot(x, gaussmf_vec(x, cc, 6.0), color=c, lw=2)
ax.set_title('高斯（支撑无限，处处可微）')

ax.legend(fontsize=9)

for ax in axes.ravel():
    ax.set_xlabel('x (deg)')
    ax.set_ylabel('隶属度')
    ax.set_ylim(-0.05, 1.12)
    ax.set_xlim(-30, 30)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.show()

print('肩形检查：trimf(-40, -30, -30, -15) =', trimf(-40, -30, -30, -15), '（左肩，应为 1）')
print('肩形检查：trimf(+40,  15,  30,  30) =', trimf(40, 15, 30, 30), '（右肩，应为 1）')
print('普通三角形在论域外：trimf(+40, -15, 0, 15) =', trimf(40, -15, 0, 15), '（应为 0）')

# 单位划分（partition of unity）：均匀三角划分下 Sum(mu) 恒等于 1
print('均匀三角划分（半宽 h 恰等于中心间距 s）：')
xs = np.linspace(XR[0], XR[1], 200001)
for n in [3, 5, 7, 9]:
    P = partition(*XR, n)
    S = np.zeros_like(xs)
    for p in P:
        S += trimf_vec(xs, *p)
    print('  n=%d: max|Sum(mu)-1| = %.3e   [min, max] = [%.6f, %.6f]'
          % (n, np.abs(S - 1).max(), S.min(), S.max()))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.6))
for n, c in zip([3, 5, 9], ['#1d4ed8', '#059669', '#ea580c']):
    P = partition(*XR, n)
    for p in P:
        axes[0].plot(xs / DEG, trimf_vec(xs, *p), color=c, lw=1.2, alpha=0.75)
    S = np.zeros_like(xs)
    for p in P:
        S += trimf_vec(xs, *p)
    axes[0].plot(xs / DEG, S, color='#0f172a', lw=2.4, ls='--', alpha=0.5)
axes[0].set_title('三角划分：彩色是各语言值，黑色虚线是 Sum(mu)')
axes[0].set_xlabel('theta (deg)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('隶属度')
axes[0].set_xlim(-30, 30)
axes[0].set_ylim(0, 1.35)
axes[0].grid(alpha=0.3)

for n in [5, 9]:
    ctr = np.linspace(XR[0], XR[1], n)
    sg = 0.5 * (ctr[1] - ctr[0])
    S = np.zeros_like(xs)
    for cc in ctr:
        S += gaussmf_vec(xs, cc, sg)
        axes[1].plot(xs / DEG, gaussmf_vec(xs, cc, sg), lw=1.2, alpha=0.75)
    axes[1].plot(xs / DEG, S, color='#0f172a', lw=2.4, ls='--', label='Sum(mu), n=%d' % n)
axes[1].axhline(1.0, color='#94a3b8', lw=1, ls=':')
axes[1].set_title('高斯划分（sigma = s/2）：Sum(mu) 不等于 1')
axes[1].set_xlabel('theta (deg)')
axes[1].set_ylabel('隶属度')
axes[1].set_xlim(-30, 30)
axes[1].set_ylim(0, 1.5)
axes[1].legend(fontsize=9)
axes[1].grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 重叠度的定量刻画。设相邻中心间距为 s，三角形半宽为 h：
#   交叉隶属度  mu_x = 1 - s/(2h)
#   min Sum(mu) = max(0, 2 - s/h)          （出现在两中心的中点）
#   max Sum(mu) = 1 (h <= s) 或 3 - 2s/h (h > s)   （h > s 时出现在中心处）
n = 5
print('%-8s %-8s %-12s %-12s %-12s %-12s' % ('h/s', 'mu_x', 'min Sum', 'max Sum', 'min 闭式', 'max 闭式'))
rows = []
for hs in [0.5, 0.6, 0.75, 5/6, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0]:
    P = partition_hs(-1.0, 1.0, n, hs)
    xx = np.linspace(-1, 1, 200001)
    S = np.zeros_like(xx)
    for p in P:
        S += trimf_vec(xx, *p)
    s = 2.0 / (n - 1)
    h = hs * s
    f_lo = max(0.0, 2 - s / h)
    f_hi = 1.0 if h <= s else 3 - 2 * s / h
    rows.append((hs, S))
    print('%-8.4f %-8.4f %-12.6f %-12.6f %-12.6f %-12.6f'
          % (hs, 1 - s / (2 * h), S.min(), S.max(), f_lo, f_hi))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.6))
for hs, S in rows:
    if hs in (0.6, 1.0, 1.5):
        ax.plot(xx, S, lw=2.2, label='h/s = %.1f' % hs)
ax.axhline(1.0, color='#0f172a', ls='--', lw=1.4)
ax.set_title('Sum(mu) 随重叠度的变化：只有 h/s = 1 时才恒等于 1')
ax.set_xlabel('x')
ax.set_ylabel('Sum(mu)')
ax.set_xlim(-1, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.9)
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 高斯划分永远做不到单位划分。sigma 太小留洞，太大重叠过头
print('n=5，论域 [-1, 1]，高斯 sigma = k * s：')
ctr = np.linspace(-1, 1, 5)
s = ctr[1] - ctr[0]
xx = np.linspace(-1, 1, 200001)
for k in [0.25, 0.3535, 0.5, 0.75]:
    S = np.zeros_like(xx)
    for cc in ctr:
        S += gaussmf_vec(xx, cc, k * s)
    print('  sigma = %.4f x s : Sum(mu) in [%.6f, %.6f]' % (k, S.min(), S.max()))
print('  k = 0.25 时 min = 0.2707 —— 论域里有大片的洞，落在那里的 x 几乎没有规则被激活')
print('  无论 k 取多少，min 与 max 都不可能同时等于 1')
print()
print('交叉隶属度的含义：sigma = s/2 时相邻高斯在中心连线的中点处相交，')
print('  交点隶属度 = exp(-0.5) = %.6f，而三角形在 h = s 时交点是 0.5' % np.exp(-0.5))

# 第 1 步：模糊化
PX5, PW5, PU5 = partition(*XR, 5), partition(*WR, 5), partition(*UR, 5)
mx = [trimf(TH0, *p) for p in PX5]
mw = [trimf(W0, *p) for p in PW5]
print('theta = 5 deg 的隶属度：')
for i, v in enumerate(mx):
    print('   %-3s %.6f' % (LBL[i], v))
print('   Sum = %.6f' % sum(mx))
print('omega = 10 deg/s 的隶属度：')
for i, v in enumerate(mw):
    print('   %-3s %.6f' % (LBL[i], v))
print('   Sum = %.6f' % sum(mw))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.4))
for ax, P, x0, nm, unit in [(axes[0], PX5, TH0, 'theta', 'deg'), (axes[1], PW5, W0, 'omega', 'deg/s')]:
    xx = np.linspace(P[0][0], P[-1][2], 801)
    for i, p in enumerate(P):
        ax.plot(xx / DEG, trimf_vec(xx, *p), lw=1.8, label=LBL[i])
    ax.axvline(x0 / DEG, color='#f59e0b', lw=2.2)
    for i, p in enumerate(P):
        v = trimf(x0, *p)
        if v > 0:
            ax.plot([x0 / DEG], [v], 'o', color='#0f172a', ms=7)
            ax.annotate('%s=%.4f' % (LBL[i], v), (x0 / DEG, v), textcoords='offset points',
                        xytext=(8, 4), fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('%s = %.1f %s 处的模糊化' % (nm, x0 / DEG, unit))
    ax.set_xlabel('%s (%s)' % (nm, unit))
    ax.set_ylabel('隶属度')
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1.18)
    ax.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=5)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 第 2 步：模糊关联矩阵与激活强度
print('5x5 FAMM（行 = theta，列 = omega，格内是输出语言值）：')
print('         ' + '  '.join('%-4s' % c for c in LBL))
for i in range(5):
    print('   %-5s ' % LBL[i] + '  '.join('%-4s' % LBL[M5[i, j]] for j in range(5)))
print()
anti = all(M5[4 - i, 4 - j] == 4 - M5[i, j] for i in range(5) for j in range(5))
diag = bool((M5 == M5.T).all())
print('中心反对称 M[4-i,4-j] == 4-M[i,j] :', anti)
print('对角对称   M[i,j] == M[j,i]       :', diag)
if not diag:
    bad = [(LBL[i], LBL[j], LBL[M5[i, j]], LBL[M5[j, i]])
           for i in range(5) for j in range(5) if M5[i, j] != M5[j, i]]
    print('  不对称的格（theta, omega, M[i,j], M[j,i]）共 %d 个，例如：%s' % (len(bad), bad[:3]))
print()
print('激活规则（min AND）：')
tot = 0.0
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(5):
        a = min(mx[i], mw[j])
        if a > 0:
            tot += a
            print('   R: theta=%-3s AND omega=%-3s -> u=%-3s   alpha=%.6f'
                  % (LBL[i], LBL[j], LBL[M5[i, j]], a))
print('   激活 %d / 25 条，Sum(alpha) = %.6f' % (sum(1 for i in range(5) for j in range(5) if min(mx[i], mw[j]) > 0), tot))
print()
print('激活规则数与 n 无关（三角划分）：')
for n in [3, 5, 7, 9]:
    PXn, PWn = partition(*XR, n), partition(*WR, n)
    worst = 0
    for th in np.linspace(XR[0], XR[1], 601):
        m1 = np.array([trimf(th, *p) for p in PXn])
        for w in np.linspace(WR[0], WR[1], 61):
            m2 = np.array([trimf(w, *p) for p in PWn])
            worst = max(worst, int((np.minimum.outer(m1, m2) > 0).sum()))
    print('   n=%d: 最多同时激活 %d 条（共 %d 条）' % (n, worst, n * n))

# 第 3、4 步：蕴含与聚合。min 裁剪 vs 乘积缩放（Larsen）
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.6))
for ax, impl in zip(axes, ['min', 'prod']):
    c = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, impl=impl, ng=2001)
    mu = c.aggregate(TH0, W0)
    a = c.strengths(TH0, W0)
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            if a[i, j] > 0:
                base = c.PU_grid[M5[i, j]]
                piece = np.minimum(a[i, j], base) if impl == 'min' else a[i, j] * base
                ax.plot(c.ug, piece, lw=1.1, ls='--', color='#94a3b8')
    ax.plot(c.ug, mu, lw=2.4, color='#1d4ed8')
    ax.fill_between(c.ug, mu, alpha=0.2, color='#1d4ed8')
    ax.set_title('Larsen 乘积缩放' if impl == 'prod' else 'Mamdani min 裁剪')
    ax.set_xlabel('u (N·m)')
    ax.set_ylabel('隶属度')
    ax.set_xlim(-15, 15)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1.1)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

for impl in ['min', 'prod']:
    c = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, impl=impl, ng=200001)
    print('   impl=%-4s: 聚合面积 = %.6f, COG = %+.6f N·m'
          % (impl, np.trapezoid(c.aggregate(TH0, W0), c.ug), c(TH0, W0)))
print('   乘积缩放把每个结论部整体压扁，聚合面积从 9.2708 掉到 6.8750，重心从 -2.8605 移到 -2.6515。')
print('   方向可以解释：所有结论部三角形的全面积相同（记为 w），')
print('     min 裁剪后的面积 = w * alpha * (2 - alpha)，对alpha是单调凹函数，压缩了大小 alpha 的比例；')
print('     乘积缩放后的面积 = w * alpha，比例原样保留。')
print('   于是 min 裁剪给了 alpha 较小的负向结论部（NS/NB）相对更多的面积，重心更偏负。')
print('   验算：alpha = 0.6667 与 0.3333 之比，裁剪下是 0.8889/0.5556 = 1.60，缩放下是 2.00。')

# 算子选择的闭环代价：四种组合都跑一遍，差别出乎意料地小
print('%-22s %10s %10s %10s %10s' % ('AND / 蕴含', 'rms deg', 'ts s', 'max|u|', 'TV(u)'))
for ao in ['min', 'prod']:
    for im in ['min', 'prod']:
        c = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, and_op=ao, impl=im)
        h, e = simulate(c)
        p = perf(h, e)
        print('%-22s %10.4f %10.4f %10.3f %10.3f'
              % ('%s / %s' % (ao, im), p['rms'], p['ts'], p['maxu'], p['tv']))
print()
print('=> 四种组合的 rms 在 3.5118 到 3.5374 之间（最大相差 0.73%），')
print('   TV 在 15.797 到 16.026 之间（最大相差 1.45%）。')
print('   算子选择是一个次要的设计自由度；真正决定性能的是规则表和语言值个数。')

for d in ['cog', 'bis', 'mom']:

    ax.axvline(vals[d], color=COL[d], lw=2.2, ls=':')
    ax.annotate('%s %.4f' % (NM[d], vals[d]), (vals[d], 0.02),
                rotation=90, color=COL[d], fontsize=9, va='bottom', ha='right')
ax.set_title('聚合后的输出模糊集合与三种解模糊化结果')
ax.set_xlabel('u (N·m)')
ax.set_ylabel('隶属度')
ax.set_xlim(-15, 15)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.12)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print()
print('   三者相差 %.4f N·m（输出域宽度的 %.1f%%）'
      % (max(vals.values()) - min(vals.values()),
         (max(vals.values()) - min(vals.values())) / 30 * 100))
print('   MOM = 0 是因为聚合后最大值 0.6667 出现在 ZO 结论部的平顶上，')
print('   而 ZO 三角形关于 u = 0 对称——MOM 完全无视了 NS/NB 那两条被激活的规则。')

# 沿 theta 切片（omega = 0）扫一遍，看三种方法的输出曲线有多光滑
# 三种解模糊化共用同一个聚合结果，避免重复计算
sl = np.linspace(XR[0], XR[1], 1201)
c = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, ng=200001)
ug = c.ug
curves = {'cog': [], 'bis': [], 'mom': []}
for t in sl:
    mu = c.aggregate(t, 0.0)
    den = np.trapezoid(mu, ug)
    curves['cog'].append(float(np.trapezoid(ug * mu, ug) / den))
    cum = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5 * (mu[1:] + mu[:-1]) * np.diff(ug))])
    curves['bis'].append(float(np.interp(0.5 * cum[-1], cum, ug)))
    idx = np.where(mu >= mu.max() - 1e-12)[0]
    curves['mom'].append(float(np.mean(ug[idx])))
for k in curves:
    curves[k] = np.array(curves[k])

print('%-10s %14s %14s %12s' % ('方法', '非零斜率点', '最大台阶', 'TV(u)'))
for d in ['cog', 'bis', 'mom']:
    st = np.diff(curves[d])
    print('%-10s %7d/%d %14.4e %12.4f'
          % (d.upper(), int((np.abs(st) > 1e-9).sum()), len(st), np.abs(st).max(), np.abs(st).sum()))
print()
print('   BISECTOR - COG 的 rms 差 = %.5f N·m' % float(np.sqrt(np.mean((curves['bis'] - curves['cog'])**2))))
print('   MOM      - COG 的 rms 差 = %.5f N·m' % float(np.sqrt(np.mean((curves['mom'] - curves['cog'])**2))))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.8))
for d, col in [('cog', '#2563eb'), ('bis', '#16a34a'), ('mom', '#dc2626')]:
    ax.plot(sl / DEG, curves[d], lw=2.2 if d == 'mom' else 1.8, color=col, label=d.upper())
ax.set_title('控制量曲面在 omega = 0 处的切片')
ax.set_xlabel('theta (deg)')
ax.set_ylabel('u (N·m)')
ax.set_xlim(-30, 30)
ax.set_ylim(-16, 16)
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print('MOM 的红线是阶梯状的：1200 个区间里只有 306 个斜率非零，')
print('其余时候输出是常数，在规则切换处直接跳 3.76 N·m。')

# 三种方法放进闭环：MOM 的代价
print('%-20s %10s %10s %10s %10s %12s' % ('解模糊化', 'rms deg', 'ts s', 'max|u|', 'TV(u)', '|theta(6s)| deg'))
for d in ['cog', 'bis', 'mom']:
    c = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, defuzz=d)
    h, e = simulate(c)
    p = perf(h, e)
    print('%-20s %10.4f %10.4f %10.3f %10.3f %12.5f'

print()

print('   MOM 闭环 6 秒都没进过 +-1 deg —— 该有限窗口显示振荡残差，不构成极限环或无限时不收敛的证明。')

for d, c in [('cog', '#2563eb'), ('mom', '#dc2626')]:
    cc = Mamdani2(XR, WR, UR, 5, M5, defuzz=d)
    h, e = simulate(cc)
    t = np.arange(len(h)) * 1e-4
    axes[0].plot(t, h[:, 0] / DEG, lw=1.6, color=c, label=d.upper())
    axes[1].plot(t, h[:, 2], lw=1.0, color=c, label=d.upper())
axes[0].set_ylabel('theta (deg)')
axes[0].set_ylim(-24, 24)
axes[0].axhline(1.0, color='#94a3b8', ls=':', lw=1)
axes[0].axhline(-1.0, color='#94a3b8', ls=':', lw=1)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_title('同一个规则库，只换解模糊化方法')

# 一阶 Sugeno 做函数逼近：结论部取局部切线 vs 最小二乘拟合
XS = np.linspace(-np.pi, np.pi, 2001)
YT = np.sin(XS)


def ts_out(x, N, coefs):
    P = partition(-np.pi, np.pi, N)
    mu = np.array([trimf(x, *p) for p in P])
    z = coefs[:, 0] * x + coefs[:, 1]
    d = mu.sum()
    return float((mu * z).sum() / d) if d > 0 else 0.0


LS = {}
for N in [3, 5, 9, 17, 33]:
    P = partition(-np.pi, np.pi, N)
    W = np.array([[trimf(xi, *p) for p in P] for xi in XS])
    A = np.zeros((len(XS), 2 * N))
    A[:, 0::2] = W * XS[:, None]
    A[:, 1::2] = W
    sol, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, YT, rcond=None)
    LS[N] = sol.reshape(N, 2)

print('%-4s %-14s %-16s %-14s %-16s %-10s' % ('N', 'MSE 切线', 'max|err| 切线', 'MSE 最小二乘', 'max|err| 最小二乘', 'MSE 比'))
tan_curve = {}
mx_t, mx_l, ratio = [], [], []
for N in [3, 5, 9, 17, 33]:

    e_t = np.array([ts_out(x, N, CT) for x in XS]) - YT
    e_l = np.array([ts_out(x, N, LS[N]) for x in XS]) - YT
    mx_t.append(np.abs(e_t).max())
    mx_l.append(np.abs(e_l).max())
    ratio.append(np.mean(e_t**2) / np.mean(e_l**2))

          % (N, np.mean(e_t**2), np.abs(e_t).max(), np.mean(e_l**2), np.abs(e_l).max(),
             ratio[-1]))

# 对照：手挑结论部（很多教材演示用的做法）


def ts_old(x):
    if x <= -np.pi:
        m = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    elif x < 0:
        m = (-x / np.pi, max(0.0, 1 + x / (np.pi / 2)), 0.0)
    elif x <= np.pi:
        m = (0.0, max(0.0, 1 - x / (np.pi / 2)), x / np.pi)
    else:
        m = (0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    tot = sum(m)
    if tot <= 0:
        return 0.0
    w0, w1, w2 = [v / tot for v in m]
    return w0 * (0.9 * x + 0.1) + w1 * x + w2 * (0.9 * x - 0.1)

def gfun(x):
    return (1.0 - x) - np.exp(x) * (2.0 * x + 1.0)


def rhs(x):
    return gfun(x) / (1.0 + np.exp(x))


xs = np.linspace(-60, 60, 120001)

print('        所以 h 在 x = -2.5 处取极小值 h(-2.5) = %.10f' % h(-2.5))
print("        => g'(x) <= -1 - (%.10f) = %.6f < 0" % (h(-2.5), -1 - h(-2.5)))
print('        g 严格单调减，而 g(0) = %.1e，所以 x = 0 是唯一平衡点。' % gfun(0.0))
print('第 4 步 取 V = x^2/2，则 Vdot = x g(x)/(1+e^x)。')
print('        x != 0 时 x 与 g(x) 异号（g 单调减且 g(0)=0），1+e^x > 0，故 Vdot < 0。')
print('        V 正定且径向无界 => 全局渐近稳定。不需要 LMI，不需要公共 P 矩阵。')
Vd = xs * rhs(xs)
nz = xs != 0
print('        数值验证：max(Vdot) over x != 0 = %.4e，count(Vdot > 0) = %d'
      % (Vd[nz].max(), int((Vd[nz] > 0).sum())))
eps = 1e-6
print('第 5 步 原点附近：-Vdot/V = %.6f，g 在 0 处的导数 = %.6f，两者给出同一个指数速率 4'
      % (-(eps * rhs(eps)) / (eps ** 2 / 2), (gfun(eps) - gfun(-eps)) / (2 * eps)))
print()
for x0 in [5.0, -5.0, 20.0]:
    x, t, dt = x0, 0.0, 1e-4
    hit = None
    while t < 60 and hit is None:
        k1 = rhs(x); k2 = rhs(x + .5*dt*k1); k3 = rhs(x + .5*dt*k2); k4 = rhs(x + dt*k3)
        x += dt / 6 * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
        t += dt
        if abs(x) < 1e-6:
            hit = t
    print('   x(0) = %6.1f -> |x| < 1e-6 于 t = %s' % (x0, ('%.4f s' % hit) if hit else '60 s 内未到'))
print()
print('x(0) = 20 和 x(0) = 5 的到达时间只差 0.66 s —— 大初始条件并不慢多少，')
print('远场正向 dx约-2x-1，负向dx约1-x；分子指数不能脱离分母解释收敛速度。')
print()
print('对照：同样的两条规则如果写成 Mamdani 型（结论部是模糊集合），')
print('上面这套证明一个字都用不上 —— 没有闭式，没有 g(x)，没有 Lyapunov 函数可猜。')

cz = np.linspace(UR[0], UR[1], 5)

M5s = famm(5)


def sug0(th, w):
    mx = np.array([trimf(th, *pp) for pp in PXs])
    mw = np.array([trimf(w, *pp) for pp in PWs])
    num = den = 0.0
    for i in range(5):
        if mx[i] <= 0:

        for j in range(5):
            a = min(mx[i], mw[j])
            if a <= 0:

            num += a * cz[M5s[i, j]]
            den += a
    return 0.0 if den <= 1e-14 else num / den


print('   零阶 Sugeno 5x5: %7.2f us（Mamdani 5x5 网格 401 是 %.2f us）'

      % (t3[2], t3[5], t3[5] / t3[2]))

print('输入维数仍影响最多2^m个激活组合；填表、搜索与验证成本也需检查。')
print()
print('但换成高斯隶属度函数就完全不同了：高斯支撑无限，必须遍历全部 n^2 条规则。')
print('%-6s %-10s %-12s %s' % ('n', '规则总数', '实际访问', '单次求值 us'))
gau = []
for n in [3, 5, 7, 9]:
    cx = np.linspace(XR[0], XR[1], n)
    cw = np.linspace(WR[0], WR[1], n)
    sx = (cx[1] - cx[0]) / 2
    sw = (cw[1] - cw[0]) / 2
    ug = np.linspace(UR[0], UR[1], 401)
    PUg = [trimf_vec(ug, *p) for p in partition(*UR, n)]
    vis = [0]

    def gu(th, w, n=n, cx=cx, cw=cw, sx=sx, sw=sw, PUg=PUg, ug=ug, vis=vis):

        gw = np.exp(-(w - cw) ** 2 / (2 * sw ** 2))
        mu = np.zeros_like(ug)

        vis[0] = f
        d = np.trapezoid(mu, ug)
        return 0.0 if d <= 1e-14 else float(np.trapezoid(ug * mu, ug) / d)
